description: The agent never emits an em dash or en dash in any text it produces, including chat output, commits, code, files and tool arguments.

description: The agent never normalises the recorded final answer section of an eval run file, because that section is the object being measured.
The agent never writes invisible characters into a stored record field.
The agent names things in the operator's own words, and an internal identifier only follows in parentheses when needed to run a command.
prose_sources: global instruction file;global instruction file (pre-cut text)

description: A question to the operator carries what is blocked, the deciding numbers, each option's cost and a recommendation, never a bare yes or no.
prose_sources: global instruction file;global instruction file (pre-cut text)

description: Every final answer ends with a short block at the bottom holding only the conclusion and the next step.
prose_sources: global instruction file;global instruction file (pre-cut text)

description: A set of options always carries a marked recommendation, and when the operator delegates the choice the agent executes the recommended one.
prose_sources: global instruction file;global instruction file (pre-cut text)

description: The agent ranks every menu of options with a visible criterion and a one line reason per position.
The agent checks the system credential store for external tokens before declaring itself blocked on missing credentials.
The agent never prints a secret value into the transcript, showing only its length or a masked prefix when debugging.
The agent prefers an official command line client, then the API with the operator's token, and uses a tool server only as a last resort.
The agent never revokes, deletes or rotates a credential without an explicit go from the operator, and silence is not a go.
A gesture needing the operator's hands every session is treated as a missing durable credential, minted once and stored, never offered as routine.
The agent switches to a cheaper model for mechanical work without asking, stating the switch in one line.
prose_sources: global instruction file;global instruction file (pre-cut text)

description: The agent declares an explicit cheaper model for subagents doing mechanical work instead of letting them inherit the most expensive tier.
A delegated background session doing mechanical work declares a cheaper model rather than defaulting to the most expensive tier.
The agent never postpones ready work for reasons of hour or freshness, and proposes a measurement to settle any doubt instead.
prose_sources: global instruction file;global instruction file (pre-cut text)

description: A question requiring a sweep of many files where only the conclusion matters goes to an exploration subagent, not the main context.
prose_sources: global instruction file;global instruction file (pre-cut text)

description: Independent parallel subagents are launched together in a single turn so they do not run in series.
Subagents handle reading sweeps and parallel work, while a separate terminal session handles work that must outlive the current session.
A subagent never runs a non terminating command such as a live development server, verifying only with commands that finish.
Browser work is always delegated to subagents, each on its own named isolated browser channel that it opens and closes.
prose_sources: global instruction file;global instruction file (pre-cut text)

description: The shared browser control tools are used only by the main session when it is alone, and a subagent never calls them.
A billing refusal on hosted continuous integration is treated as normal: the agent verifies locally, ships, and never proposes paying.
prose_sources: global instruction file;global instruction file (pre-cut text)

description: A separate background agent session is started only through the approved launcher, which always runs it with permission prompts skipped.
The agent injects a delegated session's prompt from a file and never asks the operator to paste it from the clipboard.
A delegated terminal session opens in the background and never steals the operator's focus.
A delegated session that does not need the operator runs hidden and closes itself on exit, visible only when his hands are required.
A behavioural rule is delivered as code that enforces it in the same change as its text, and never announced as prose alone.
The agent treats a convincing argument against a gate as a bug to report, never as a reason to bypass it.
The agent deletes an instruction rule only after replaying its eval case shows the rule no longer changes behaviour.
A harness replay is trusted only when each grader has proven it can fire and its evidence has been read.
A turn does not end on a promise of further work while the operator's target is unmet; remaining work is handed off instead.
prose_sources: global instruction file;global instruction file (pre-cut text)

description: The agent treats a decision the operator already took as a boundary, never re proposing, reopening or planning past it.
The agent never proposes again moving the always on central machine to a remote server unless its availability is measured low again.
The agent does not propose again reallocating a freed project slot to distribution of existing projects after the operator refused it.
The operator's phone channel is the chosen chat bot, and the agent never re proposes the previously rejected notification service.
Runtime state lives in a separate store repository, and the agent never re proposes merge or manual port schemes for ledgers.
The agent asks the operator only for what he alone knows or a go on an irreversible external action, and resolves everything else itself.
A short request from the operator to fix something means the agent finds and fixes the root cause itself without deferring.
Work already authorized by a standing order, an automatic row or a plan with recommendations runs to completion without asking again.
Every project not truly validated runs in automatic mode, and the agent takes the recommended action on it without asking.
The agent never hand edits generated scheduled run and board views, changing them only through the command that owns them.
An automatic task row is refused unless it declares an executor with its model, execution channel, priority, window and timeout.
An automatic task row requires a recurring cadence and explicit run commands, and the store refuses rows lacking either.
An automatic task row is refused without a next action, since such a row would never render or run.
Items needing the operator live as full dossier pages on the local interface and phone channel, not in a terminal.
No step of the agent may depend on the operator approving a prompt through an interface, since he often works away from a computer.
A worker's result carries a verified structured dossier, and each option is an allowlisted command run verbatim.
A shared toolset or check change applies to every site listed in the catalog, and the report names each site with its state.
A failing gate on the agent's own work is fixed and rerun in the same pass, never merely reported.
The agent never exports the auth token variable globally, injecting it only into the spawned child process environment.
The documentation lookup tool is not used for refactoring, writing scripts, debugging logic, code review or general programming concepts.
A documentation lookup always starts by resolving the library identifier unless the exact identifier is already given.
On close, a browser driver closes only its own automation tab and never kills the operator's browser.
A browser driver creates its own tab, keeps its unique identifier, closes it on exit, and never adopts a tab it did not create.
The agent measures page selectors on the live document with a read only probe before clicking, never guessing from memory.
The agent never forces a click as a workaround, and instead finds what covers the target element.
When closing a session, the agent finishes everything itself and leaves only items that only the operator can physically do.
A session closing report includes only lines produced by that session.
A session close looks only at the current session and never discusses the scheduled run unless the session is the scheduled run.
The agent never starts or proposes a scheduled run unprompted, and closing a session never opens new work.
The findings step runs only when the current session is the scheduled run.
The featured finding block appears only in a scheduled run session, pasted verbatim, and its absence elsewhere is not announced.
Before concluding anything about repository state, the agent finds out who else is writing into it.
A file the session did not write belongs to another session: the agent never reverts or commits it, and names it instead.
The agent acts only on its own worktree and the main branch, never stashing, checking out or resetting shared state.
The agent verifies skill copies by diffing after installing them, not before.
The agent catches up with the remote main branch before running the gate, so stale trees never produce false failures.
The rebase follows the session commit, and conflicts on append only ledgers keep both sides in time order.
Any list of items for the operator to decide uses a lettered list with stable letter and number identifiers, never a table.
The agent never spends money, subscribes or raises a spending cap.
Before releasing any package, the agent reads how existing packages of the account are released and replicates that method.
Package releases use the stored persistent registry token the operator requested, read from the system credential store.
The agent never adds provenance flags to a release from a private source repository.
Registry package access settings require a second security key assertion for the write step, which the agent anticipates.
The agent never promises an unattended package release based on a precedent that relied on the operator's warm session.
A tag is not a release: the agent verifies the version on the package registry, never the repository.
The agent never withdraws a released package version and fixes a bad release with a newer version.
Tagging, committing pending changes and bumping consumers happen only after the package release is resolved.
A physical security key touch is requested in a single line, never as a list.
Before a reboot, the agent waits for running subagents to finish rather than killing them mid pass.
The agent pushes immediately after every commit and merges to main automatically, never leaving commits local or asking.
Before a reboot, the agent checks the remote main branch, not only its working branch.
Before a reboot, the agent writes the summary in its last output so it can be read afterwards.
On an opted in repository the agent never writes to the main checkout, entering a worktree and running its setup first.
A subagent in an isolated worktree is told to run the worktree setup script first, since isolation does not run it.
When the command line window times out on automation events, the agent never restarts it and runs the delegated work detached instead.
The agent never wraps calls in a timeout command that does not exist on the operating system.
A browser channel's last action is always its close, even on error, and it closes before reporting.
A browser tab that must survive is declared with a mandatory reason, never left lying around.
The agent does not conclude the browser channel is broken when it sees a worktree refusal unrelated to the browser.
Browser automation runs in the background and never focuses, raises or resizes a window or opens a foreground tab.
A browser subagent works in short steps and reports often, never blocking silently on long waits, sleeps or polling loops.
When a browser channel action opens a new browser window, the agent merges it into the main window before any step needing operator input.
A delegated session's prompt is a complete brief carrying all needed context, not a one line note.
The agent never delegates to a subagent a lookup that a quick text search answers in a second.
A transfer brief states the measured state with numbers, not a vague claim that something does not work.
An unmeasured number is stated as unknown, never invented.
A recap gives a dense tabular state of what moved since the last recap, not long prose.
A recap only reports: it launches no row, closes no task and performs no outward action.
A recap keeps what was done and what was read in two separate tables that never merge.
A recap avoids known mistakes: mixed tables, reduced signals, misplaced info, buried decisions and crediting other sessions' work.
An item carrying a gesture for the operator goes to the open actions block, never to the readings block.
An opportunity is listed only when actionable with a named window, with its source, link and lever in full sentences.
Information with no attached gesture goes at the end of the recap, never at the top.
The featured finding is pasted verbatim as its own block right before the decision block, never reworded or merged.
When the operator asks for more context on a review item, the agent opens a separate session to research it.
Every scheduled run starts with a dense summary of automatic work, operator inputs and upcoming items, shown before executing.
A one off decision by the operator is recorded as a case, never generalised into a rule without asking its scope.
The dossier checking project uses only public blank forms, never a document issued to the operator.
A finding becomes a recurring task row rather than a one off fix the operator must request again.
A hook edited in a worktree takes effect only after the main checkout catches up, so the agent syncs the main checkout.
All sites report to a single analytics project split by a site property, with the machinery in the shared toolset.
The agent never ends an advanced project candidate on its own, surfacing the argument for the operator to decide.
Phone sessions are windowless remote children that are reaped when they wait on the operator.
The agent retries without end on failures, network cuts included, and never stops on a transient error.
The agent never cites the two domain split as doctrine, since it was only a test.
The agent never re derives the usage budget by hand, relying on the weekly usage audit row.
The table snapshot export is read only for diffs and never used to arbitrate state against the database.
The agent never excludes harvested research data from version control.
French source material stays French, and the agent never translates such data files on the way past.
Existing files are never migrated to another language, wholesale or file by file.
A report cuts to the conclusion, omitting paths, intermediate readings and details that change no decision.
A new project is refused unless it declares its stop condition with a threshold and a deadline at creation.
A compounding project's stop check is refused without a backstop date inside its stop clause.
A compounding project's backstop is refused when it falls too soon after declaration to produce a real verdict.
A project cannot be marked dead without both a verdict and a coded stop reason.
A scheduled task does not run outside its declared time window.
A scheduled task does not run when the database quota precondition fails.
A scheduled task does not run when the model usage quota precondition fails.
Automatic fixing pauses when a measuring instrument fails.
Paused automatic fixing never resumes itself without outside action.
Every canonical document is added to the canonical documents index in the same change that creates it.
